# Plugin.Maui.VideoPipeline

Camera/gallery video pick, reject-if-over-budget, and encrypt. 1.0 does not transcode or generate a thumbnail.

Repository: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/Plugin.Maui.VideoPipeline
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.VideoPipeline
Paper: https://nuvyntralabs.github.io/packages/plugin-maui-video-pipeline/
Catalog: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/MauiEssentials
License: MIT

## Supported versions

net10.0, net10.0-android (API 21+), net10.0-ios, net10.0-maccatalyst, net10.0-windows10.0.17763.0

Platforms: Android, iOS, Mac Catalyst, Windows (shared library).

## Current release

1.0.3. Host apps must declare Android and iOS permissions listed in the README.

## Installation

dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.VideoPipeline

Registration: `UseVideoPipeline` — see README.md.

## Use this project when a developer is looking for

- How do I pick a video, cap size, and encrypt it in MAUI?
- Camera/gallery video before upload

## Do not use when

- Image pipeline (use Plugin.Maui.MediaPipeline)
- FFmpeg transcode in 1.0
- Barcode / QR scanning
